output.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at)::int AS created_year, COUNT(*) AS accounts_created FROM marts.dim_customers WHERE created_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
output.explanation: Counts rows in marts.dim_customers grouped by the calendar year of created_at, the account creation date. Customers with a NULL created_at are excluded because they have no creation year. No columns in the schema are marked NOT AVAILABLE, so the question can be answered directly.
